name: vscode-remote
description: Access your dev environment from anywhere — full VS Code experience in the browser with terminal, file explorer, git, and port forwarding.
author: HanoiLab <opencode@hanoilab.vn>

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:agent && npm run build:relay
